short_meaning: Warns of a sharp curve to the left or right.
short_action: Slow down to navigate the sharp curve safely.

short_meaning: Warns that the road terminates ahead and joins a crossroad.
short_action: Slow down and prepare to turn left or right.

short_meaning: Warns of a dead end where the road is closed ahead.
short_action: Slow down and prepare to turn left or right.

short_meaning: Warns that part of the roadway is temporarily closed to traffic.
short_action: Slow down and follow the indicated detour route.

short_meaning: Warns that the traffic signals at the intersection are not functioning.
short_action: Slow down, treat as a multi-way stop, and yield.

short_meaning: Shows the directional route to follow to reach a major road.
short_action: Follow the directional arrows to reach the main route.

short_meaning: Shows advance directions leading towards a major transport terminus.
short_action: Follow the signs to reach the airport, harbour, or station.

short_meaning: Points out the turning direction leading directly to a transport terminus.
short_action: Turn in the indicated direction to reach the terminus.

short_meaning: Shows map directions to join a numbered route via dual carriageways.
short_action: Select the correct lane for your intended travel direction.

short_meaning: Confirms the official route number and status of your current road.
short_action: Confirm that you are travelling on your intended numbered route.

short_meaning: Indicates the route number of an intersecting urban secondary road.
short_action: Slow down for the intersection and check your route.

short_meaning: Warns that you are approaching a numbered secondary route intersection.
short_action: Prepare to turn onto or cross the numbered route.

short_meaning: Overhead sign guiding drivers to the correct lane for numbered routes.
short_action: Move into the lane corresponding to your target route.

short_meaning: Points towards an alternative non-toll route reaching your destination.
short_action: Turn here if you wish to avoid paying toll fees.

short_meaning: Indicates the presence of a dedicated bicycle route.
short_action: Watch for cyclists and avoid driving on their route.

short_meaning: Shows route numbers and destinations reachable at the upcoming intersection.
short_action: Select the correct lane before reaching the junction.

short_meaning: Shows route numbers and destinations at the intersection layout.
short_action: Turn in the direction indicated for your destination.

short_meaning: Confirms destination names and remaining distances in kilometres.
short_action: Note the remaining distance to plan your journey.

short_meaning: Points toward minor local destinations or rural side routes.
short_action: Slow down and turn towards your specified destination.

short_meaning: Illustrates the upcoming intersection layout, route numbers, and destinations.
short_action: Choose your lane early based on the intersection map.

short_meaning: Overhead sign indicating which lane leads to specific destinations.
short_action: Move into the designated lane for your destination.

short_meaning: Warns that a freeway off-ramp exit is 2 kilometres ahead.
short_action: Move to the left lane early if exiting.

short_meaning: Warns that a freeway off-ramp exit is 1 kilometre ahead.
short_action: Signal and remain in the left lane to exit.

short_meaning: Indicates that a freeway off-ramp exit is 500 metres ahead.
short_action: Maintain position in the left lane if exiting.

short_meaning: Marks the exact location of a freeway exit off-ramp.
short_action: Turn off onto the off-ramp if leaving freeway.

short_meaning: Marks the dividing gore area between a freeway and an off-ramp.
short_action: Pass left to exit or right to remain on freeway.

short_meaning: Shows lane destinations at the intersection ending an off-ramp.
short_action: Select the correct lane before reaching the end.

short_meaning: Shows turning choices at the terminal intersection of an off-ramp.
short_action: Slow down and turn left or right as needed.

short_meaning: Lists consecutive freeway exits leading to the same urban area.
short_action: Identify which numbered exit you need to take.

short_meaning: Warns that your road crosses a freeway with access ahead.
short_action: Prepare to enter the freeway on-ramp if desired.

short_meaning: Indicates the entrance location for a near-side freeway on-ramp.
short_action: Slow down and turn left onto the on-ramp.

short_meaning: Warns that a far-side freeway on-ramp entrance lies ahead.
short_action: Move to the right lane to prepare to join.

short_meaning: Indicates the entrance location for a far-side freeway on-ramp.
short_action: Turn right onto the on-ramp to join freeway.

short_meaning: Overhead sign showing a freeway split into different destination routes.
short_action: Position your vehicle in the lane for your route.

short_meaning: Shows diagrammatically that a traffic lane ends ahead.
short_action: Merge safely into the continuing traffic lane.

short_meaning: Shows diagrammatically that an extra lane is added ahead.
short_action: Move into the new lane if space permits.

short_meaning: Diagram showing mandatory restrictions applied to a specific lane.
short_action: Comply with the regulatory sign governing your lane.

short_meaning: Shows diagrammatically that two separate traffic lanes merge into one.
short_action: Yield and merge smoothly into the open lane.

short_meaning: Shows diagrammatically that multi-lane roadways converge without lane loss.
short_action: Watch for converging vehicles and maintain your lane.

short_meaning: Guides runaway vehicles with brake failure towards an arrestor bed.
short_action: Drive directly into the arrestor bed if brakes fail.

short_meaning: Advises heavy vehicle drivers to select lower gears on downhills.
short_action: Engage low gear before starting down the steep incline.

short_meaning: Overhead diagram showing the entrance lane to an arrestor bed.
short_action: Do not enter this lane unless experiencing emergency failure.

short_meaning: Overhead diagram indicating regulatory requirements for the lane below.
short_action: Follow the command or prohibition shown for your lane.

short_meaning: Count-down markers indicating distance to an exit in hundreds of metres.
short_action: Prepare to exit as the distance counts down.

short_meaning: Informational sign showing that the road terminates in a cul-de-sac.
short_action: Do not enter unless accessing local properties inside.

short_meaning: Informs you that your road has priority at the intersection.
short_action: Proceed with caution while ensuring cross traffic yields.

short_meaning: Indicates a parking area connected to public bus or train transport.
short_action: Park here to continue travel using public transport.

short_meaning: Provides secondary details supporting a primary traffic sign above it.
short_action: Read the extra details to understand the main sign.

short_meaning: Indicates the location of an official tourist information centre.
short_action: Park nearby if seeking local travel or tourist details.

short_meaning: Informational sign marking a section used for temporary road experiments.
short_action: Drive carefully and watch for experimental equipment or workers.

short_meaning: Traffic lights are timed to stay green if driving recommended speed.
short_action: Maintain the recommended speed to catch green lights.

short_meaning: Traffic light sequence differs from normal, allowing non-simultaneous greens.
short_action: Wait for your specific signal to turn green before moving.

short_meaning: Informational sign warning of a bus stop located ahead.
short_action: Watch for stopping buses and pedestrians crossing nearby.

short_meaning: Indicates a facility where passengers transfer between transport modes.
short_action: Slow down and watch for pedestrians changing transport.

short_meaning: Transverse road line marking where vehicles must stop completely.
short_action: Bring your vehicle to a complete standstill behind line.

short_meaning: Transverse road marking showing where drivers must yield right of way.
short_action: Slow down or stop to give way to cross traffic.

short_meaning: Painted road markings designating a crossing point for pedestrians.
short_action: Yield right of way to pedestrians crossing the roadway.

short_meaning: Solid line marking prohibiting straddling or crossing to overtake.
short_action: Keep to the left and do not cross line.

short_meaning: Double solid lines prohibiting crossing or driving on the right.
short_action: Do not cross or drive over these solid lines.

short_meaning: Solid white line separating traffic lanes moving in same direction.
short_action: Stay within your lane and do not cross line.

short_meaning: Pavement markings indicating the outer left or right road boundary.
short_action: Keep to the right of the left-edge line marking.

short_meaning: Painted island marking a neutral zone where driving is prohibited.
short_action: Do not drive, stop, or park over painted island.

short_meaning: Demarcated road lines indicating authorized parking space boundaries.
short_action: Park entirely within the lines marking the bay.

short_meaning: Parking bay reserved exclusively for specified vehicle classes or users.
short_action: Do not park here unless matching the designated symbol.

short_meaning: Lane arrows compelling traffic to travel only in indicated directions.
short_action: Proceed only in the direction shown by your lane arrow.

short_meaning: Pavement markings designating a lane restricted exclusively to buses.
short_action: Do not drive in this lane during active hours.

short_meaning: Yellow criss-cross box marking prohibiting stopping within the intersection.
short_action: Do not enter unless your exit path is clear.

short_meaning: Zig-zag line markings prohibiting stopping before a pedestrian crossing.
short_action: Do not stop or overtake within this marked zone.

short_meaning: Solid painted line along the kerb prohibiting all stopping.
short_action: Do not stop your vehicle alongside this line marking.

short_meaning: Broken painted line along the kerb prohibiting parking of vehicles.
short_action: You may stop briefly, but do not park here.

short_meaning: Pavement markings defining a lane reserved exclusively for pedal cyclists.
short_action: Do not drive motor vehicles within this marked lane.

short_meaning: Directional arrows showing mandatory movement direction around a circle.
short_action: Travel clockwise around the circle following arrow directions.

short_meaning: Pavement symbol warning that a railway level crossing lies ahead.
short_action: Slow down and prepare to stop for approaching trains.

short_meaning: Broken line marking indicating a lane drop or upcoming exit ramp.
short_action: Yield to merging traffic if changing lanes across lines.

short_meaning: Broken center line separating traffic traveling in opposite directions.
short_action: Watch for oncoming traffic over the dividing line.

short_meaning: Markings indicating a lane where traffic direction reverses by time.
short_action: Check signals to ensure lane is open in your direction.

short_meaning: Pavement marking warning that a yield sign is ahead.
short_action: Slow down and prepare to yield at upcoming junction.

short_meaning: Pavement arrows warning that traffic lanes decrease in number ahead.
short_action: Merge early into the continuing lane shown by arrow.

short_meaning: Pavement arrow warning that a mandatory direction turn lies ahead.
short_action: Change lanes early if you need another direction.

short_meaning: Pavement warning that a solid line prohibition starts ahead.
short_action: Return to your left lane before solid line begins.

short_meaning: Pavement markings guiding out-of-control heavy vehicles into an arrestor bed.
short_action: Drive onto the gravel bed only if experiencing brake failure.

short_meaning: Pavement markings indicating the exact location of a speed hump.
short_action: Reduce speed before driving over the painted speed hump.

short_meaning: Broken line defining lanes of traffic moving in same direction.
short_action: Keep your vehicle centered within the marked lane lines.

short_meaning: Broken guidance lines marking turning paths through an intersection.
short_action: Follow the line markings while making your turn.

short_meaning: Pavement arrow markings indicating that additional lanes open ahead.
short_action: Drive centered within marked lanes without straddling lines.

short_meaning: Pavement arrow guidance indicating allowed direction of travel per lane.
short_action: Drive only in the direction pointed by pavement arrows.

short_meaning: Transverse road markings defining a crossing area for pedal cyclists.
short_action: Watch for cyclists crossing the roadway within markings.

short_meaning: Pavement symbols designating reserved areas or routes to specific places.
short_action: Do not use marked lane unless matching designated group.

short_meaning: Words painted on road providing additional instructions or warnings.
short_action: Read the road text and comply with stated instruction.

short_meaning: Traffic light signals regulating right of way at intersections.
short_action: Obey signals stop on red, prepare to stop on amber.

short_meaning: Overhead signals showing lane availability, closure, or mandatory direction.
short_action: Drive in green arrow lanes and exit red cross lanes.

short_meaning: Hand signals by traffic officers overriding standard signals and rules.
short_action: Follow officer hand signals over all other traffic rules.

short_meaning: Flag signals manually given to stop or allow traffic flow.
short_action: Stop or proceed depending on the displayed flag signal.

short_meaning: Warning flag signal instructing drivers to proceed slowly and alertly.
short_action: Reduce speed and stay alert through the controlled area.

short_meaning: Warns of a railway crossing with one or more tracks ahead.
short_action: Slow down and stop at least 3m back if train approaches.
